name: course
role: legacy regression; previously used for development

queries.information_need: User wants a tool to recover/crack Wi-Fi (WEP/WPA) passwords.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page is about a tool that cracks or captures Wi-Fi keys/handshakes.

queries.information_need: User wants a tool to find/exploit SQL injection.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page documents a tool that detects or exploits SQLi.

queries.information_need: User wants to learn how to scan ports / a port scanner.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page explains port scanning or documents a port scanner.

queries.information_need: User wants to intercept / inspect encrypted HTTPS traffic (man-in-the-middle proxy).
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page documents a tool or method that intercepts or decrypts HTTPS/TLS traffic (e.g. mitmproxy, burpsuite, Wireshark TLS decryption).

queries.information_need: User wants a scanner for web app vulnerabilities.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page documents a web vulnerability scanner.

queries.information_need: User wants to capture/analyze network traffic.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page is about packet capture/sniffing.

queries.information_need: User wants to use/run a Metasploit exploit module.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page explains Metasploit modules/exploitation.

queries.information_need: User wants to unpack / decompile an Android app (APK) to read its code.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page documents a tool or method to unpack, decompile or reverse an APK / Android app (e.g. apktool, jadx, dex2jar, Frida on Android).

queries.information_need: User wants to enumerate directories/files on a web server.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page is about web content/directory discovery.

queries.information_need: User wants to get a reverse shell on a target.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page explains how to create or catch a reverse shell (e.g. msfvenom payloads, GTFOBins reverse-shell entries, netcat).
